user.title: Smarter Dumb Washer
user.description: Select the plug power sensor and the washer door sensor.

data_description.power_sensor: Smart plug power entity, in watts
data_description.start_power_threshold: Power at or above this value starts a cycle
data_description.idle_power_threshold: Power below this value can end a cycle. Must be below the start threshold
data_description.end_delay: How long power must stay idle before the cycle ends
data_description.door_closed_start: A cycle starts only while the door is closed

error.same_entity: Power sensor and door sensor must be different entities.
error.idle_not_below_start: Idle power threshold must be below the start power threshold.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured.
